patch_apply_message: Patch applied to 'docs/supported-platforms.md' cleanly; '.gitlab-ci.yml' had merge conflicts due to HEAD divergence. The patch changes are CI-only and do not affect source code.

analysis_summary.notes: The patch only modifies .gitlab-ci.yml (CI pipeline configuration) and docs/supported-platforms.md (documentation). No source code files, public headers, exported symbols, library interfaces, CLI behavior, configuration formats, or any other API/ABI-relevant code was touched. The change swaps which MSYS2 environment (mingw32 -> clang64) is used as the default CI runner for merges, coverage, GIR data, and docs generation. This is a pure infrastructure/CI change with zero compatibility implications for GLib library users.
